svg.title: Afterglow for ReactOS CD booklet, inside (pages 2 and 3), smooth

path.data-text: AFTERGLOW FOR REACTOS™
GETTING STARTED
Start the computer from this disc, or give it to a virtual machine as its CD.
The menu, “ReactOS (Afterglow) Boot Media”, starts the Live Environment:
ReactOS runs from the disc and nothing is installed.
To install, choose “ReactOS (Afterglow) Setup (Text Mode)” and follow Setup. It
formats the partition you pick.
Afterwards, start “ReactOS (Afterglow)”. The stock “ReactOS” entry stays in the
menu as the fallback.
ON THIS DISC
The full ReactOS 0.4.16: every application, game, screen saver and font
The Afterglow visual style, colour schemes and 20 wallpapers
Afterglow icons, pointers, Start button, logon banner and boot logo
afterfetch, from any command prompt
Wine Gecko, so the Internet Browser works
LICENSES, NOTICE.txt and CHANGES.txt
